title: Jantt Plan Specification v1
description: The JSON Gantt chart specification for Jantt.

isoDate.description: Calendar date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

dependencyType.description: FS = finish-to-start (default), SS = start-to-start, FF = finish-to-finish, SF = start-to-finish.

lag.description: Lag in days (negative = lead). When set (even 0) it replaces the gap; without it FS links use gapDays/defaultGapDays and SS/FF/SF links use 0.

lagDays.description: Alias for lag (takes precedence when both are set).

oneOf.description: Task ID, or typed shorthand '<id>:<FS|SS|FF|SF>[+/-<n>d]' (e.g. 'design:SS+2d', 'build:FF-1d'), or '<id>+<n>d' for an FS lag.

dependsOn.description: Prerequisite links: a single ID/shorthand (comma-separated strings are also accepted), a dependency object, an array of either, or null.

workingCalendar.description: Working-time calendar used for working-day scheduling.

workingDays.description: Working weekdays: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday (or names such as 'Mon'). Defaults to Monday-Friday.

region.description: Statutory holiday region: US (federal), UK/GB (England & Wales), EU, CA (federal), AU (national). Weekend substitute days are applied.

exceptions.description: Day-specific overrides that force a working day or a day off (they win over holidays).

calendarRef.description: A preset name ('standard', 'continuous', 'compressed_4x10'), the id of an entry in top-level 'calendars', or an inline calendar.

$schema.description: URI reference to the Jantt JSON Schema.

meta.description: Chart metadata, global bounding dates, and scheduling defaults.

title.description: Human-readable title of the project or schedule.

person.description: Owner, assignee, or subject of the plan.

start.description: The earliest date visible on the chart timeline (YYYY-MM-DD).

end.description: The latest date visible on the chart timeline (YYYY-MM-DD).

defaultGapDays.description: Default gap (in days) between a predecessor's end and the start of a finish-to-start successor, used when neither the link nor the task sets its own lag/gapDays. Negative values allow overlap.

targetDate.description: Contractual completion deadline used for float (negative when breached) and PERT on-time probability.

showCriticalPath.description: Whether critical path highlighting is enabled by default.

showBaselines.description: Whether baseline ghost bars are rendered.

autoCascade.description: When false (Strict mode), edits never move dependent tasks; dependency violations are reported as warnings instead.

calendar.description: Project-wide working calendar. When set, scheduling uses working days unless useWorkingDays is false.

useWorkingDays.description: Use working-day arithmetic (skip weekends/holidays) when cascading dates.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or date string of when this plan was created.

categories.description: Open map of category keys to presentation styling and human labels.

color.description: Hex or CSS color code for the task bar fill and theme highlights (e.g. '#4FAE93').

soft.description: Optional softer/darker accent color for badges or background tints.

calendars.description: Named working calendars referenced by meta.calendar, task.calendar / calendarId and person.calendar / calendarId.

documents.description: Optional list of prerequisite documents or artifacts tracked across tasks.

notes.description: Shared project notes (Markdown), optionally attached to tasks.

teams.description: Optional list of functional teams or squads (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Design').

id.description: Unique identifier for the team, referenced by person teamId or task teamId.

color.description: Hex color used for team badges and styling.

people.description: Optional list of team members who can be assigned to tasks.

id.description: Unique identifier for the person, referenced by task assignee.

name.description: Display name of the team member.

teamId.description: Unique ID of the team this person belongs to (references teams[].id).

avatar.description: Avatar image as an https: URL, or initials. Other URL schemes are reported as warnings and should not be loaded.

color.description: Hex color used for visual avatar badge (e.g. '#4FAE93').

username.description: Canonical GitHub username mention handle (e.g. '@username') for verified account teammates.

email.description: Email address of the team member.

calendar.description: Personal working calendar applied to tasks assigned to this person when working days are enabled.

calendarId.description: ID of an entry in top-level 'calendars'.

tasks.description: List of scheduled tasks/milestones displayed in the Gantt chart.

id.description: Unique identifier for the task, referenced in dependsOn.

category.description: Category key matching one of the keys defined in top-level 'categories'.

start.description: Start date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD, on or after start). The bar is drawn through the end day; scheduling durations are measured as end - start days. A milestone has end = start.

gapDays.description: Days between a predecessor's end and this task's start for finish-to-start links without an explicit lag (overrides meta.defaultGapDays). Negative values allow overlap.

locked.description: If true, the task is never moved by the cascade or by dragging; dependency violations are reported as warnings.

milestone.description: Renders the task as a diamond and schedules it with zero duration (keep end equal to start).

progress.description: Completion ratio between 0.0 and 1.0 (rendered as progress fill inside the bar).

status.description: Execution status ('done' is an alias of 'completed').

priority.description: Priority used by resource leveling and views.

assignee.description: ID of the assigned team member (references people[].id) or assignee name.

teamId.description: ID of the assigned team/squad (references teams[].id).

calendar.description: Task-specific working calendar (always uses working-day scheduling).

calendarId.description: ID of an entry in top-level 'calendars'.

baseline.description: Originally planned dates for variance tracking.

color.description: Bar color override: a plain CSS color (hex, rgb()/hsl(), var(--token) or a color name). Other values are ignored and reported as INVALID_COLOR warnings.

pert.description: Three-point duration estimate in days used by PERT and Monte Carlo. Missing values default to 80% / 100% / 135% of the planned duration.

fields.description: Arbitrary domain-specific key-value pairs rendered in the detail panel (e.g. optimisticDuration / mostLikelyDuration / pessimisticDuration for PERT).
